smart_covers.name: Smart Covers
smart_covers.what: The categorized cover library as a product: browsable in Smart Factory AND offered at page-creation time. Shawn 2026-10-25: people love done-for-you parts they get to pick - 'I picked it' is the feeling that attracts builders.
flow: 1. DEFAULT FIRST: every page is born with a cover already chosen by the system (area cover by page type) - nobody ever faces a blank page or a forced decision.
2. OPTIONAL CHOOSER: during page creation (and anytime after, via Change cover) the citizen may open Smart Covers: categories and search, FEATURED covers first, never the whole shelf dumped at once.
3. SMART SUGGESTION: using what the citizen told us (Welcome answers, page type, stated purpose), the system suggests the best-matching covers first - the auto-match idea applied to covers.
4. SKIP IS FREE: 'pick for me' is always one tap; the default is already beautiful.
5. CUSTOM PATH: any cover can be used as-is, or as the reference for a Naya-made custom version.
smart_covers.organization: three brand tiers (signature / jewel / open) x categories (abstract colorways, the-dimension, prosperity, sanctuary, celebration, craft, cosmos) - the manifest is the shelf data; featured = a rotating curated subset, seeded by Shawn's verdicts.

chooser_everywhere.ruling: Shawn, 2026-10-25 ~22:04Z: the cover library is choosable on ANY page. Every page's cover control offers two doors: CHOOSE FROM OUR LIBRARY or UPLOAD YOUR OWN PHOTO. A page is never blank and never locked: by default the system places the relevant cover (area default / matched pick); the citizen can swap it for any library cover or their own upload at any time; the position adjuster applies to both library picks and uploads.
chooser_everywhere.the_match_card: Every library photo carries a match card: a proper NAME, its CATEGORY (shelf), its ABOUT (what it is and who it suits - the 'suits' field), its tier, and the TYPICAL TERMS people search by (typical_terms map above) plus mood tags. Those cards are what the match game plays with: the chooser searches them, the smart suggestion scores them against the citizen's own words (Welcome answers + page purpose), and the default picker reads them. A photo without a complete match card does not enter the library.
chooser_everywhere.defaults: Page type sets the first default (area cover for branded/area pages; matched open cover for citizen pages); the citizen's own words refine it. Skip is always one tap; the default is always already beautiful.

demand_map.source: Deep research 2026-10-25 (SBA 2025 profile, Shopify/StoreInspect, Etsy, GoDaddy, APPA, HFA, ICF, Reddit/Facebook community sizes) - full report in research notes.
headline_findings: Offline, services dominate: professional services/coaching is the #1 small-business sector (4.88M US firms); construction/trades 3.66M; real estate 3.51M; health care 2.95M; retail 2.81M.
Online inverts it: Shopify stores are Fashion 25.5%, Home & Garden 13.3%, Beauty 8.3%, Food & Beverage 6.6%, Health & Wellness 5.2%, Sports & Fitness 3.5%.
Communities run on humour, pets (r/aww 38M members), food (multiple 3-6M groups), and faith (multi-million-member groups).

Pets: 94M US pet-owning households, $152B spend (APPA). Health & fitness: 81M US facility members; wellness economy $6.8T. Coaching: $5.34B, ~123k practitioners (ICF). Food: 1M+ US outlets, $1.5T sales.
AI/SaaS is tiny by firm count (Information sector 1.3%) but ~90% of YC 2025 batches - small numbers, highest growth and pay intent; the abstract facet family already speaks its language.
demand_map.lock_in: Build the road to 60 by demand cluster, not by taste: Companions (pets) NEW shelf direction x4-6 - professional services/coaching scenes x3 - health & energy x3 more - food & hospitality x3 - craft & makers x4 - earthly nature/outdoors x3 - commerce/prosperity scenes x3 - clean professional register x3 - celebrations +2 - faith & community welcome x2 - membership progression set x2.
demand_map.likely_missed_by_others: other-services invisibles (salons, repair, pet care - 3.86M firms), skilled trades (creator demand +103% YoY), weddings/events vendors (~900k), solo real-estate agents, churches/non-profits (373k congregations).

typical_terms.purpose: Shawn's rule (2026-10-25 ~21:58Z): every area of life people build pages around must be findable by the TYPICAL words they would type. This map is the coverage contract: area -> plain search terms -> the covers that answer them. Status: covered / partial / owed. The chooser searches these terms plus the mood tags.

match_doctrine.law: Shawn, 2026-10-25 ~22:09Z: everything in the system gets categorized, labeled and organized so it can be pulled, used and found - covers, pages, smart notes, people, systems. This is one fabric with the auto-match engine: a massive game of match, played by intelligence with logic, automatically. No card, no entry: an asset without a complete match card (name, category, about/suits, tier, typical terms, credit, status) does not enter the library.
match_doctrine.scope: This manifest is the covers instance of the doctrine. The same card discipline applies to pages (page registry), smart notes (the Smart Note door), citizens and spaces (the match corpus) - one matching fabric across NayaNET.
match_doctrine.arrival_protocol: Every image Shawn or any Naya contributes is carded on arrival: slotted to 1920x640, named, categorized, described, term-mapped, credited - then added here and pushed with the library.
